ظؤرة: ظُؤْرَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph.
ظؤري: ظُؤْرَى A cow desiring the male: (K:) mentioned by Az, on the authority of AHát; and said to have no verb. (TA. [But see 10, above.])
ظؤار: ظُؤَارٌ : see ظِئْرٌ, in four places.
ظؤور: ظَؤُورٌ : see ظِئْرٌ, in two places.
ظؤورة: ظُؤُورَةٌ Inclination to, or affection for, the young one of another: (M, K:) it may be an inf. n., as well as a pl. [of ظِئْرٌ]. (M.) === Also [The relation in which one stands by being a ظِئْر, or nurse:] like عُمُومَةٌ and خُؤُولَةٌ &c. (TA.) === See also ظِئْرٌ, latter half.
